kaa.solution_md: Funkciya óssedi ($3>1$ hám $k=3>0$), sonlıqtan ekstremumlar kesindi ushlarında: $f(1)=-\frac{5}{3}$, $f(4)=7$. Juwap: $7$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tiykar 1 den kishi yamasa $k<0$ bolǵanda monotonlıq baǵıtın aralastırıw (eń úlken mánisti qáte ushta esaplaw).

en.stem_md: Find the largest value of $f(x)=3\cdot 3^{x-3}-2$ on the segment $[1;\ 4]$.
en.solution_md: The function is increasing ($3>1$ and $k=3>0$), so the extrema are at the ends of the segment: $f(1)=-\frac{5}{3}$, $f(4)=7$. Answer: $7$.
en.mistake_note_md: Mixing up the direction of monotonicity when the base is below 1 or $k<0$ (evaluating the maximum at the wrong end).
